question.value: Does the magnetic field traced by the Velocity Gradient Technique on PHANGS-ALMA 12CO(2-1) in NGC 628 align with the spiral arms and curve around kpc-scale bubbles seen in JWST mid-infrared emission?

evidence.quote: In this work, we aim to study the magnetic field in and around the bubbles structures of the spiral galaxy NGC 628 at the distance of 7.3 Mpc (cite: 2004AJ....127.2031K)
The large-scale magnetic field is oriented parallel to the spiral arms and curves around the galactic bubble structures in the mid-infrared emission observed by the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST).
In this work, we select $^{12}$CO (2-1) emission as the main tracer to measure the magnetic field of the spiral galaxy NGC628 with the VGT technique.
The spatial resolution for NGC 628 is $\sim$ 1.12$''$ (FWHM $\sim$ 53.5 pc) and the velocity resolution is around 2.5 km s$^{-1}$ (cite: 2021ApJS..257...43L).
high signal-to-noise ratio data with the RMS noise level of $\sim$ 0.30 $\pm$ 0.13 K km s$^{-1}$.

analysis_steps.goal: Select CO cube and thin velocity channels

method.value: Use the PHANGS-ALMA 12CO(2-1) PPV cube as VGT input and treat velocity channels as thin channels

evidence.quote: The input of the VGT technique is the high-resolution position-position-velocity (PPV) data cube of the $^{12}$CO emission in this work.
The spatial resolution for NGC 628 is $\sim$ 1.12$''$ (FWHM $\sim$ 53.5 pc) and the velocity resolution is around 2.5 km s$^{-1}$ (cite: 2021ApJS..257...43L).

method.value: Pixelised x and y gradients of each thin channel map, orientation from arctan(grad_y/grad_x), for pixels with S/N > 3

evidence.quote: The (x,y) two-dimensional position will be displayed in the (RA,DEC) plane of the sky for pixels whose spectral line emission has a signal-to-noise ratio greater than 3, which is high enough for credibility.

The (x,y) two-dimensional position will be displayed in the (RA,DEC) plane of the sky for pixels whose spectral line emission has a signal-to-noise ratio greater than 3, which is high enough for credibility.

assumptions.value: B-field is perpendicular to the velocity gradient in each sub-region

evidence.quote: The orientation of the magnetic field is perpendicular to the velocity gradient direction in each sub-region.

analysis_steps.goal: Derive B-field orientation map by sub-block averaging

method.value: Sub-block averaging of gradient orientations, pseudo-Stokes Q_g and U_g weighted by channel intensity, psi_g = 0.5 arctan(U_g/Q_g), psi_B = psi_g + 90 deg; displayed with LIC

evidence.quote: The size of the sub-block is set as 20 $\times$ 20 pixels, which determines the size of the final magnetic field resolution.

key_parameters.value: sub-block 20x20 pixels, pixel size 0.2'', B-field scale 191 pc (~4'')

evidence.quote: Using the VGT technique, the magnetic field is derived at a scale of 191 pc ($\sim$ 4$''$) with the sub-block size set at 20$\times$20 pixels and with a pixel size of the $^{12}$CO emission of 0.2$''$.

validation.value: Compared with synchrotron polarization B-field using AM (step 6)

evidence.quote: We smooth the magnetic field derived by VGT to the same scale as that from JVLA resolution ($\sim$ 18$''$) and compare the two versions of the magnetic field.

analysis_steps.goal: Refine with Velocity Decomposition Algorithm for the two largest bubbles

method.value: Replace channel intensity with the VDA velocity component before computing gradients, to remove density contribution

evidence.quote: Using these velocity properties $p_v$ to replace the values for Ch(x,y) in Eq. [\[eq.a4\]](#eq.a4) and [\[eq.a5\]](#eq.a5), this VGT-VDA method can trace the magnetic field better.

analysis_steps.goal: Correct VGT orientation at shock fronts

findings_qualitative.value: The large-scale B-field from VGT runs parallel to the spiral arms and curves around bubble shells, matching low-resolution synchrotron polarization

evidence.quote: The large-scale magnetic field is oriented parallel to the spiral arms and curves around the galactic bubble structures in the mid-infrared emission observed by the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST).

claims.hypothesis: VGT on PHANGS-ALMA CO traces the same B-field as synchrotron polarization at matched resolution
claims.experiment: Smooth the VGT B-field to 18'' and compute AM against the JVLA 3.1 GHz polarization field
claims.result: Mean AM approaches 0.53 over the disk; 0.70 for Bubble 1
claims.finding: VGT B-field orientations are nearly parallel to those inferred from synchrotron polarization

evidence.loc: 4.3.1 The B-field in the galactic disk
evidence.quote: The magnetic field derived by VGT is basically consistent with the previous results obtained from synchrotron polarization.

claims.hypothesis: VGT orientation must be corrected where shocks parallel to B change the velocity gradient
claims.experiment: Re-rotate VGT by 90 degrees along the OIII-traced shock front of Bubble 2 and recompute AM
claims.finding: VGT tracing is tested in the shock front region and requires a 90 degree re-rotation there

evidence.quote: In the region of the shock front, the VGT orientation needs to be re-rotated 90$^\circ$.

claims.hypothesis: Removing the density contribution (VDA) improves VGT accuracy
claims.experiment: Apply VGT-VDA to the two largest bubbles and compare AM with VGT alone
claims.finding: VGT-VDA traces the B-field more accurately than VGT alone

evidence.quote: This means that the VGT-VDA has higher accuracy in tracing magnetic fields than only the VGT method

claims.hypothesis: Large-scale bubbles are caused by multiple supernovae and shape the local B-field
claims.experiment: Compare B-field curvature, OIII shocks, mid-IR emission and synchrotron flux scaling for 20 bubbles
claims.result: B-field is curved and parallel to the bubble shells; alpha ~ 1; up to 194 estimated SNRs in Bubble 1
claims.finding: The bubbles are likely produced by multiple supernova explosions and prolonged star formation

evidence.quote: The bubble structure appears to be caused by repeated supernova explosions and prolonged star formation

why_this_data.value: PHANGS-ALMA provides high-resolution CO data from which turbulence anisotropy and velocity gradients can be extracted

evidence.quote: The PHANGS-ALMA survey provides high-resolution CO isotopolog data where anisotropies of the turbulence can be extracted and used to trace the velocity gradients of eddies.

limitations_admitted.value: It is unknown how many supernovae contributed to the typical bubble size

evidence.quote: it is unknown how many SNs actually contributed to this large size.

limitations_admitted.value: The characteristic flux I_0 is unknown, so the SNR number estimate assumes k = 1

evidence.quote: Because of the unknown characteristic flux $I_0$, we assume the factor k as 1.

referee_caveats_inferred: No uncertainties are given on most AM values, and the AM depends on arbitrary sub-regions and smoothing to 18''.
The 90 degree re-rotation at shocks is applied only after comparing with polarization, which makes the Bubble 2 AM partly circular.
SNR counts rest on k = 1 and R_0 = 6 pc and are order-of-magnitude estimates only.
The paper does not say which PHANGS-ALMA data product, mask or smoothing was used.

data_public_as_stated.value: Archival PHANGS-ALMA, PHANGS-MUSE, JWST ERO and JVLA data are cited as survey or published products

evidence.quote: The details of the archival data are shown in Section [2](#sect2).

missing_for_reproduction: Exact PHANGS-ALMA cube product and release
VGT and VDA code version and parameter files
Channel selection, velocity range and noise clipping details
Region masks for Bubbles 1 and 2 and for the shock front
Flux measurements and fitting details behind alpha and the SNR counts
No ALMA project code printed in the paper
reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Small (a single PHANGS-ALMA NGC 628 CO(2-1) cube, order of a few GB) plus JWST, MUSE and JVLA maps
reproducibility.score_reason: Data are public survey products, but VGT parameters, region definitions and fitting details are not given and no code is released.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: The key results (AM values) depend on unstated masks, smoothing and VGT settings, so the recipe is not complete enough to redo.
